detail: String 14 in array B ran 18 C above neighbours during thermal survey; fuse F14 found blown.
resolution: Fuse replaced within 30 hours; confirmation flight showed normal thermal profile.

detail: Gusts reached 13.2 m/s mid-patrol; automatic RTL triggered at 62 percent battery.
resolution: Mission rescheduled next morning; wind limit for refinery-02 reaffirmed at 8 m/s sustained.

detail: 4G link quality fell to 28 percent near the northern sidings; aircraft held position then executed RTL.
resolution: Ethernet MQTT fallback verified; northern sidings marked as low-coverage in mission planner.

detail: Analyst flagged a critical hotspot that was cloud-shadow transition; no baseline image was attached.
resolution: SOP updated: baseline image mandatory for state-change anomalies before raising high or critical alerts.

detail: Hatch actuator stalled at 40 percent open during self-check.
resolution: Dock placed in MAINTENANCE; actuator replaced; D-04 grounded pending clearance.
